display.purpose: The big number in each stat-strip cell.

headline.purpose: Page title in the top bar; section titles at 18px.

title.purpose: Map name on a match panel; settings panel titles.

body-small.purpose: Meta lines, help text, captions, compact buttons.

label.purpose: Uppercase data labels only: table headers, inline stat captions, result word, YOU/THEM tags.

number.purpose: Every figure: scores, K/D/A, counts, durations. Digit runs inside text switch to it at 0.94em.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Video player and update dialog only.

shadows.name: keycap-lip
shadows.purpose: Bottom edge of a keyboard key.

shadows.name: scrim
shadows.purpose: Backdrop behind overlays; opaque, never blurred.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: The single easing for framer-motion transitions.

motion.name: quick
motion.purpose: Page crossfade: opacity 0 to 1, y 4px to 0.

motion.name: slide
motion.purpose: Shared-layout indicators: sidebar active block, filter-tab underline, settings nav block.

motion.name: css-state
motion.purpose: Colour and border transitions on hover; switch thumb 180ms.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: MotionConfig reducedMotion="user"; CSS transitions and the status ping disabled under prefers-reduced-motion

components.css: :host{--canvas:#09090b;--panel:#111113;--hover:#18181b;--line:rgb(39 39 42/.8);--line-2:#27272a;--edge:#3f3f46;--edge-h:#52525b;--ink:#fafafa;--body:#f4f4f5;--quiet:#a1a1aa;--win:#10b981;--loss:#f43f5e;--sans:'Geist Variable','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;--mono:'Geist Mono Variable',ui-monospace,monospace;}.ds-notice{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;margin:0;padding:11px 14px;border:1px solid #27272a;border-radius:6px;background:var(--panel);color:var(--body);font:14px/1.5 var(--sans)}.ds-notice svg{flex:none;margin-top:3px;color:var(--quiet)}.ds-notice b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}

narrative.overview:
CrossPOV is read like a flight instrument, not browsed like a launcher. Three near-black zinc surfaces stack with 1px hairlines between them; there is no glass, no glow and no blur. The eye goes to numbers (win rate, K/D/A, round scores, clip lengths) because they are the only things set in a second typeface, Geist Mono at semibold with tabular figures, and to two colours, because emerald and rose are the only hues on screen and each means exactly one thing.

Density is deliberate and calm: one stat strip, one row of filter tabs, then match panels that open in place. Panels are flat rectangles with 6px corners; inside a panel, content sits on hairline-separated rows rather than in nested boxes. Motion is short and purposeful (160 to 220ms, a fast ease-out with no bounce): a "you are here" block slides between nav items and tabs, a match grows open to show its fights, a page fades in 4px from below. Everything honours the viewer's reduced-motion setting.

This world replaced an earlier frosted-glass, glowing, pill-shaped look. The rejection is part of the system: translucency, coloured glows and capsule shapes do not come back.
keyCharacteristics: Three-step dark surface scale (canvas, panel, hover) separated by 1px hairlines.
Two semantic colours only: emerald for win and ready, rose for loss, error and recording.
Rectangles everywhere: 6px for containers and controls, 4px for small tags and inner options, 2px for status dots. No pills, no circles.
Geist Sans for words, Geist Mono semibold tabular for every number, including numbers inside sentences.
Lucide icons at 1.75 stroke; Phosphor only for the Twitch logo; a custom split-frame crosshair as the brand mark.
Motion is functional and brief (160 to 220ms), with shared-layout indicators and a height accordion.

rules.name: The Two Lamps Rule
rules.body: Emerald and rose are the only hues. Emerald is a win or ready; rose is a loss, an error or recording. Nothing is coloured for decoration, and no third hue (amber, purple, blue) is introduced for warnings, links or brands.

rules.name: The Neutral Warning Rule
rules.body: A warning is neutral text in a hairline box, identified by a leading Lucide triangle icon, never by colour. Only errors turn rose.

rules.name: The Glyph Not Purple Rule
rules.body: Twitch is marked by its logo glyph in the current text colour, never by Twitch purple.

rules.name: The Readout Rule
rules.body: Every number is Geist Mono semibold with tabular figures, even mid-sentence. Text that mixes words and digits ("R14 · they killed you", "37 min", "9:00 into the match") passes through the digit-run wrapper so only the digits switch face, at 0.94em.

rules.name: The Label Is Data Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked text names a value or column it sits on. It never floats above a heading as a decorative kicker.

rules.name: The Flat Panel Rule
rules.body: One panel, one hairline, no shadow, no backdrop-filter. Nothing floats unless it is an overlay.

rules.name: The No Nesting Rule
rules.body: A panel never holds another bordered card. Details inside a match sit on the panel itself as hairline-separated rows.

rules.name: The No Pill Rule
rules.body: Nothing is fully rounded: no capsule buttons, no circular avatars, no round status dots. The largest corner in the system is 6px.

dos: **Do** build every surface from canvas, panel and hover with 1px hairlines between them.
**Do** set every number in Geist Mono semibold with tabular figures, wrapping digit runs inside sentences.
**Do** use emerald only for win or ready, and rose only for loss, error or recording.
**Do** mark a warning with a leading Lucide icon on a neutral hairline box.
**Do** draw Lucide icons at 1.75 stroke (16px inline, 18px in navigation); use Phosphor only for the Twitch logo.
**Do** keep corners at 6px for containers and controls, 4px for small inner pieces, 2px for dots.
**Do** animate with the fast ease-out (160 to 220ms) and keep reduced motion respected.
**Do** place details inside a panel as hairline-separated rows.
donts: **Don't** use pills, capsules or circles anywhere: buttons, tags, avatars and status dots are rectangles.
**Don't** bring back frosted glass, backdrop blur, glows or coloured shadows.
**Don't** add a third hue for warnings, links, Twitch or decoration.
**Don't** nest a bordered card inside a panel.
**Don't** show initials as an avatar; follow the picture, agent, glyph chain.
**Don't** set numbers in the sans face, or use proportional figures in a column.
**Don't** put an uppercase tracked kicker above a heading; uppercase labels name data only.
**Don't** add shadows to anything that is not an overlay (player, dialog, toast).
